results.title: A zero-note take keeps its audio, microphone identity and useful feedback
results.detail: The real recorder keeps its audio and microphone identity, explains zero-note results persistently, and offers an original download.

results.title: Pitch edit buttons respect MIDI limits and expose selection
results.detail: Boundary actions are unavailable and selected note state is exposed to assistive technology.

results.title: Valid low and high pitches edit by exactly one semitone
results.detail: MIDI 0→1 and 127→126 remain exact semitone edits; an unavailable edit has no side effects.

results.title: Removing a note keeps keyboard focus in the melody editor
results.detail: Deletion focuses the next note, the previous note, or the empty melody area as appropriate.

results.title: Drums shows its included percussion and restores the independent toggle for other leads
results.detail: Drums visibly includes its rhythm; switching lead restores the separately editable percussion preference.

results.title: A persisted project stays saved when the library cannot refresh
results.detail: A successful POST is authoritative; a later list outage cannot undo its saved state or hide its library entry.

results.title: Reopening the current library project preserves its latest edits
results.detail: The same-project gallery snapshot cannot replace the title or edited pitches saved during reopen.

results.title: Removing every note still permits an explicit save
results.detail: The real Save control persists an intentionally empty melody and clears its dirty state.

results.title: New and Open preserve edits after the final note is removed
results.detail: Both New and Open save a dirty empty project before switching, preserving deleted notes and title edits.

results.title: Real OfflineAudioContext renders nonzero PCM WAV
results.detail: Actual PCM: 3.000s, RMS 0.02288, peak 0.17981.

results.title: Instrument and BPM controls change the rendered audio
results.detail: 199550 samples differ between Piano and Strings. Tempo: 3.000s → 2.300s including the same effects tail.

results.title: Real microphone recorder recognizes an isolated synthetic C–E–G fixture
results.detail: Synthetic QA input only: C4 @ 0.17s / 0.64s, E4 @ 1.02s / 0.64s, G4 @ 1.88s / 0.64s. Original recording: 38005 bytes. Input tracks released.

results.title: A refused re-record keeps the existing melody
results.detail: Existing pitches, timing and confidence survived the simulated permission refusal.

results.title: Cancelled microphone requests cannot affect a subsequent recording
results.detail: rejected: prior melody preserved on Cancel, later A4 captured, input resources released. late stream: prior melody preserved on Cancel, later A4 captured, input resources released

results.title: Edits made while a save is in flight remain in the project
results.detail: The server saved its snapshot; newer title and mood edits remain local and unsaved.

results.title: Stopping while audio unlock is pending leaves the studio stopped
results.detail: Delayed unlock completed without changing the stopped transport to playing.

results.title: Rendered studio controls edit, arrange, play and save the real project
results.detail: Actual DOM controls raised C4 to C♯4, selected Strings / 120 BPM, explicitly applied Cinematic, used the real arranger and CompositionPlayer, then saved and reopened the edited notes. Export gating checked; WAV signal is verified separately.

results.title: A pending microphone request disables studio mutations and Cancel preserves the melody
results.detail: Record, note editing, settings, project actions and producer controls were disabled during the isolated pending request. Cancel preserved every captured note and ignored the late refusal.

results.title: AI directions include detected notes and require an explicit Apply action
results.detail: Real rendered Producer sent instruction, settings and captured notes, labelled configuration separately from the AI result, disclosed OpenAI, and changed only settings after Apply.

results.title: A rules fallback identifies its source and displays the recovery notice
results.detail: Configured AI fell back visibly to a Rule-based result, kept the explanation inline, and left settings unchanged for review.

results.title: Changes to settings or notes discard stale directions and isolate overlapping requests
results.detail: A settings edit invalidated the first request; its late result could not replace the second request or clear its pending state. Editing notes then removed the current proposal.

results.title: Producer status stays honest while configuration is loading
results.detail: Checking and cached rules status made no false offline promise. A mocked AI response after server mode changed identified its actual source and still required Apply.

results.title: An unavailable status endpoint makes no AI or rules-only claim
results.detail: A configuration error stayed visible without a false source claim; the later actual rules result accurately identified its source.

results.title: Home HUM, DISCOVER and CREATE actions navigate and apply supported sound settings
results.detail: Actual home actions opened HUM, the sound library and a fresh studio. Ambient selected the supported Strings / Ambient controls consistently; presets and new projects created no detected notes.

results.title: A saved melody becomes a reviewed direction and composition through the reference UI
results.detail: Actual top navigation opened the only saved project. The cream producer page reviewed the real melody and AI proposal without applying or arranging. Explicit Create applied Strings / Cinematic / 100 BPM, built real chord accompaniment, opened the dark studio with transport, and saved the original notes and chosen settings.
